# Nepal

> [!summary] Data available
> Nepal has a few dozen dishes and recipes and relatively rich plant data (KNApSAcK 1,035 records). Start with [[WorldCuisines]] and [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]] for dishes and [[KNApSAcK Family]] for edible and medicinal plants; the Nepal FCT is only in the Backlog.

## Foods & dishes
- [[WorldCuisines]]: 36 dishes (6 Nepal-only); [[FmLAMA]] 4; [[World Wide Dishes]] 1 (Nepal-only).
- [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]]: 53 recipes (steps); [[RecipeDB2]] ≈80 (v1, not released).
- Not in [[BLEnD]].

## Ingredients & food composition
No FCT processed. [[Nepal Food Composition Table]] (2012 PDF, 2024 update; candidate, priority 2).

## Compounds & traditional medicine
[[KNApSAcK Family]] 1,035 records (328 edible / 707 medicinal), the most in South Asia after India; [[CMAUP]] 208 plants; [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]] 323 records, 95 taxa; [[NPASS]] 12 pairs. Ayurveda and Sowa Rigpa (Himalayan) apply through [[IMPPAT]] (Sowa Rigpa 325 plants) and [[CMAUP]] (Sowa-Rigpa 153). Global resources without country labels (FooDB, SpiceRx, FlavorDB2, Phenol-Explorer, CTD, HMDB, FoodAtlas, FooDrugs) apply via [[Global]].

## Gaps
No FCT processed, no recipe corpus with amounts, no BLEnD culture.
